activities.title: Gamja — Telok Ayer’s new gamjatang specialist
activities.description: Opened 3 Sep 2026 at 21 Boon Tat Street. Korean pork-bone stew (gamjatang) is the whole point — lunch bowls from S$15.80, sharing cauldrons at dinner, plus the traditional ramyun-then-fried-rice finish. Soju-friendly and low-fuss.
activities.why: Brand-new Korean comfort concept this month — spicy stew you won’t find at the usual KBBQ spots.
activities.parking: Street / nearby carparks; Telok Ayer or Tanjong Pagar MRT.

activities.title: Singapore River Festival 2026 — The Quay Collective
activities.description: The Singapore River Festival marks its 10th edition from 11 to 20 September 2026 with 'The Quay Collective'. All three quays get experience zones: an Acai Social dance session inside Clarke Quay's oldest heritage building, an outdoor Monopoly: Hidden Singapore clue adventure, the Whispers of the Twin Quays boat-and-…
activities.why: The 10th edition of the river festival runs through the whole week — riverside light art, dance floors and bumboat tours, mostly free.
activities.parking: Clarke Quay / Riverside Point carparks; Clarke Quay MRT nearby.

travel.geoQuery: Various venues along the Singapore River — Clarke Quay, Robertson Quay, Boat Quay, Singapore

activities.title: Public Garden — free indie art market back at Suntec
activities.description: Public Garden returns 12–13 Sep 2026, 1–7pm at Suntec Singapore (Halls 405–406). Designers, artists and makers — fashion, prints, ceramics, plus Japan’s Kotoko Bakery miniature bread sculptures (for looking, not eating).
activities.why: This weekend only — free admission art market with first-time Singapore makers.

travel.geoQuery: 1 RAFFLES BOULEVARD SUNTEC SINGAPORE CONVENTION & EXHIBITION CENTRE SINGAPORE 039593

activities.title: Kampong Gelam Festival — free heritage weekend at Sultan Gate
activities.description: Inaugural Kampong Gelam Festival 12–13 Sep 2026 (10am–10pm) at Sultan Gate Park and satellites. Free performances, workshops, Eras Trail and museum tours; some activities register at go.gov.sg/kgf2026.
activities.why: Brand-new free heritage weekend this Sat–Sun — easy couple wander through Baghdad and Bussorah.

activities.title: Mid-Autumn Festival Lanterns @ Gardens by the Bay — opening-night lantern wonderland
activities.description: Gardens by the Bay's Mid-Autumn Festival lantern display opens Saturday 12 September 2026, running 6pm–10pm daily through 27 September. Large-scale illuminated lantern sets spread across Supertree Grove, Golden Garden and Bayfront Plaza, with a marketplace, carnival games and a Colonnade of 1,000 hand-painted lanter…
activities.why: It opens on Saturday night of this week — opening night has the LED Lion Dance at 8.30pm
activities.deal: Free (workshop fees and Flower Dome tickets apply separately)
activities.parking: Car parks at Bayfront Plaza and The Meadow; nearest MRT is Bayfront (CE1/DT16)

activities.title: Gelato Messina × Butter — Milo cookies till 17 Sep
activities.description: Hong Kong bake shop Butter pops up at Gelato Messina (1 Club Street) through 17 Sep 2026. Fresh cookies daily plus SG exclusives: Milo Dinosaur cookie (S$6) and Milo Godzilla with vanilla gelato (S$12).
activities.why: Limited collab ending this Thursday — grab the Milo Godzilla before it vanishes.
activities.parking: Club Street / Telok Ayer; Tanjong Pagar MRT.

activities.title: Mom's Touch — Korea's fried-chicken giant returns
activities.description: South Korea's largest fried chicken chain (1,400+ outlets) is back in Singapore after shutting all local stores in 2022, now at 18 Cross in the CBD. The headline order is the SuperThigh Chicken Burger (S$9.95) built on a boneless fried thigh, plus Boneless Fried Chicken Thigh (from S$9.95) in four flavours including…
activities.why: The comeback story of the month — Korea's biggest chicken chain returns to Singapore after four years away.
activities.parking: Limited parking around 18 Cross; Tanjong Pagar or Telok Ayer MRT are minutes away.

activities.title: Elijah Pies flagship — soufflé + pizza pies in Joo Chiat
activities.description: Homegrown Elijah Pies opens its third and largest store on 12 Sep 2026 at 72 Joo Chiat Place — a 60-seater in a restored 1930s shophouse. Flagship-only draws: made-to-order chocolate soufflé pie, kaya toffee pie, and Chicago-style pizza pies with a 27-layer butter crust.
activities.why: Opens this Saturday — new east-side flagship with pies you can’t get at the older outlets.
activities.parking: Street / nearby; Eunos or Paya Lebar MRT + short hop.

activities.title: Sushidan — $19.90 omakase at Parkway Parade
activities.description: Michelin-starred-pedigree Sushidan opened its second Singapore outlet at Parkway Parade on 5 Sep 2026, bringing chef Hiroyuki Sato's Toyosu Market-sourced seafood to the East. The Goshoku Set (S$19.90++) is an entry-level omakase with chawanmushi, three mini dons and a sushi platter — remarkable value. From 5 to 30…
activities.why: Opened 5 Sep — east-coast omakase from S$19.90++, plus a limited uni add-on running through 30 Sep.
activities.parking: Parkway Parade carpark; Marine Parade MRT (TEL) is the nearest, or buses along Marine Parade Road.

travel.geoQuery: 80 Marine Parade Road, Parkway Parade, Singapore 449269

activities.title: HOMEGROWN Festival 2026 — free gigs with Regina Song & brb.
activities.description: HOMEGROWN Festival returns for its third edition at PLQ Plaza, Paya Lebar, from 11 to 13 September 2026. Organised by the Music & Drama Company, it's headlined by bedroom-pop star Regina Song and pop-groove favourites brb., with Forests, Ice Cream Sundays, 10pm Noise Complaint and MDC talents RINES, Dominic Chin and…
activities.why: Catch international-level Singapore talent live for free — Regina Song and brb. headline a three-day festival this weekend.
activities.parking: PLQ Mall carpark; Paya Lebar MRT is right there.

travel.geoQuery: PLQ Plaza, 10 Paya Lebar Road, Singapore 409057

activities.title: National Bikers Weekend — free Expo motorcycle festival
activities.description: Singapore’s largest motorcycle event returns 11–13 Sep 2026 at Singapore EXPO Hall 4 & Carpark C, 9am–9pm. Free public entry — brands, dealers, gear, test rides and community booths.
activities.why: This weekend only at Expo — free, loud, and actually on in the east.
activities.parking: Expo halls / Carpark C; Expo MRT.

activities.title: Na Oh — modern Korean prix-fixe inside Hyundai’s Jurong hub
activities.description: Na Oh sits inside the Hyundai Motor Group Innovation Center (2 Bulim Link) with a Korean summer four-course prix fixe (S$88) — Pyongyang cold noodles, samgyetang, and Smart Farm herbs. Book the complimentary HMGICS Discovery Tour after lunch.
activities.why: West-side destination dining you won’t stumble into — limited prix-fixe with a factory-farm tour add-on.

activities.title: Salomon's first SG outlet opens at IMM — up to 50% off
activities.description: Salomon opened its first-ever Singapore outlet at IMM on 5 September 2026, marking the occasion with opening deals of up to 50% off selected products plus exclusive gifts with purchase. The store stocks the French outdoor brand's trail-running shoes, hiking footwear and everyday athleisure — worth a look if comforta…
activities.why: First Salomon outlet in Singapore with opening-week discounts of up to 50% — the best prices you'll see on the brand for a while.
activities.parking: IMM multi-storey carpark; Jurong East MRT is next door.

travel.geoQuery: , IMM Building, 2 Jurong East Street 21, Singapore 609601

activities.title: Minecraft Experience: Villager Rescue — final days at Mandai
activities.description: Asia’s first Minecraft Experience at Green Canvas, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, runs only until 13 Sep 2026. ~55-minute timed quest; weekday from S$46 adult / S$40 child via Fever. Bundle with Zoo / Exploria for savings.
activities.why: Closes this Sunday — last chance for the Mandai Overworld walkthrough.
activities.parking: Mandai Wildlife EAST MSCP; bus to Zoo stop 48131.
activities.heatNote: Indoor halls; still humid between Mandai stops.

activities.title: One Punggol 2nd Birthday Bash — carnival + Mid-Autumn light-up
activities.description: Singapore's largest integrated community hub celebrates its 2nd anniversary with a week of free school-holiday activities — bouncy castles, inflatable play zones, kiddy rides, tabletop games and arts-and-crafts workshops. The celebrations peak on Sun 13 Sep with the Birthday Bash carnival (interactive games, gachapo…
activities.why: One-day-only birthday bash + Mid-Autumn celebration, 13 Sep
activities.when: Sun 13 Sep; bash daytime, Mid-Autumn light-up 6pm-10pm

activities.title: Tara Na! — Muslim-owned Filipino kitchen at Punggol East
activities.description: Tara Na! By Easy Eatz (Tagalog for “Let’s go!”) is a Muslim-owned Filipino spot at Punggol East Container Park (01-K35, 50 Punggol East), beside The Smok Hous. Family home kitchen turned physical store — heartland Filipino plates without a downtown detour.
activities.why: Recent north-east opening covered by HungryGoWhere — real named venue with a concrete address.
activities.parking: Container park / nearby; Punggol or Riviera MRT + short hop.

travel.geoQuery: 50 PUNGGOL EAST CITY SPROUTS @ PUNGGOL SINGAPORE 828826

activities.title: Dopamine Land — sensory play rooms at Resorts World Sentosa
activities.description: Dopamine Land Singapore is open at Weave, Resorts World Sentosa (#02-204/205) through 19 Dec 2026. Nine interactive rooms (Scribblescape, Chromodance and more). Tickets from ~S$17; closed Tuesdays.
activities.why: Still-new South attraction — playful couple or family sensory circuit without inventing a venue.

travel.geoQuery: 26 SENTOSA GATEWAY SHOWPLACE (RESORTS WORLD SENTOSA) SINGAPORE 098138
